feeds.title: Epic Reads Blog
feeds.description: Epic Reads, brought to you by HarperCollins Publishers, is the largest online community of fans of young adult books! We are a passionate, vibrant community of Book Nerds from around the world who love talking about, sharing and discovering new books. Join the EPICREADS.com community to find the hottest teen books, connect with your favorite YA authors and meet new friends who share your reading interests.

feeds.title: Confessions of a YA Reader
feeds.description: I am Kristi from Confessions of a YA Reader. Reader, reviewer, blogger, gecko breeder, married. I am usually happy to review books, but I cannot guarantee I will read it quickly if you send me something without asking me first. I will do the best I can, but I prefer YA, fantasy, or mystery/thrillers.

feeds.title: Mrs. ReaderPants
feeds.description: I started this blog in 2011 simply because I love reading and reviewing books. Initially, all my posts were book reviews and thematic booklists. While I do still write book reviews, I have gradually switched my focus from book reviews to lesson ideas and management tips for librarians and classroom teachers. Professional book reviews are widely available, but there is a huge need for librarians to share ideas with one another.

feeds.title: It Starts at Midnight
feeds.description: I prefer Young Adult, generally. And before you get sassy, I realize I no longer qualify as 'young'. But I like it. And I read pretty much any genre, as long as it isn't too fluffy.

feeds.title: Two Chicks On Books
feeds.description: Hi this is Jaime and I love to read and share my thoughts on books, TV, movies, and purses lol. I read anything but I mostly read YA books. So I hope you like my reviews and thanks for stopping by.

feeds.title: Jill's Book Blog » Young Adult
feeds.description: Explore the reviews of YA novels here. Jill is a writer in Toronto, Ontario. She reviews six books a week and she also posts blog memes daily! She has studied English, publishing, and creative writing. She also has her Masters in Creative and Critical Writing from the University of Gloucestershire. She is currently querying agents with her contemporary young adult novel about a Princess in England. She is writing a young adult fantasy novel!

feeds.title: One Reading Nurse » Young Adult
feeds.description: Explore the YA section for the reviews and opinions on young adult fiction and non-fiction books. Welcome to One Reading Nurse Reviews! My name is Athena, I'm a 30something year old RN currently living in Western NY. I have a wide range of book interests from fantasy, sci fi, thrillers, genre and literary fiction.. I read pretty much everything except romance and 'chick lit.'

feeds.title: Young Adult Book Reviews
feeds.description: Young Adult Book Reviews is a Book review site written by a high school librarian. This book review site was started by Megan Andersen, the library media specialist at Dowling Catholic High School in West Des Moines, IA.

feeds.title: Robinsons Book Blog » Young Adult
feeds.description: Join us here on our new adventure where we will bring you all the latest and greatest Young Adult book news, recommendations, reviews and so much more! Brought to you by Robinsons Bookshop, welcome to the Robinsons BookBlog! We have a long legacy of literary love amongst our company and our community! More that just booksellers, we pride ourselves in the part we play to promote reading in all its forms, to people from all walks of life.

feeds.title: Forever Young Adult Blog
feeds.description: Created in 2009, Forever Young Adult is a community for YA fans who are a little less 'Y' and a bit more 'A.' FYA is a place where bookworms can get lit(erary) and swoon over fictional characters without shame, all while sipping on a cocktail. From book reviews to TV crushes to movie drinking games, it's basically a non-stop internet slumber party, and you're totally invited! Plus, if you're looking to hang IRL, we've got an international network of book clubs buzzing with kindred spirits.

feeds.title: Katie's Book Blog
feeds.description: Katie's Book Blog is a blog all about young adult books. It has reviews, interviews, giveaways, and so much more. The mission of Katie's Book Blog is to get the word out about books for young adults and hopefully entice some reluctant readers into checking out a book or two.

feeds.title: R&R Book Tours » Young Adult
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on Virtual book tours, cover reveals, bookish events, and other publicity events. In an age of indie and self-publishing, it can be tough to introduce your book to the masses. One of the best ways of sharing your book is by making friends with a book reviewer or two. I should know, I am one. I also know a few (500+), and they would love to read your book. It also doesn't hurt that we've been in business for nearly 6 years and know a thing or two.

feeds.title: Day Leitao Blog
feeds.description: Blog about YA literature, pop culture, Star Wars, Day Leitao's books, and writing. Day Leitao is a Brazilian YA author and currently living in Canada. Read her blog to get news, updates, and nonsensical ramblings.

feeds.title: Rich in Color
feeds.description: Rich in Color is dedicated to reading, reviewing, talking about, and otherwise promoting young adult books (fiction and non-fiction) starring or written by people of color or people from First/Native Nations.

feeds.title: Tinyindiewhimsy
feeds.description: Tiny houses, Indie Books...Paranormal, Romance, Fantasy, Whimsical

feeds.title: Happy Indulgence
feeds.description: Book review blog from Australia featuring young adult reviews and discussions. I started Happy Indulgence in July 2012 as a way to share my passion with others, and it has expanded into a YA book review blog encompassing a wide range of features and genres. Happy Indulgence captures how we should blissfully enjoy life's greatest offerings, no matter what it is. Here, we share our love for YA books and all things reading!

feeds.title: Never Judge A Book By Its Cover
feeds.description: Never Judge a Book by it Cover was created back in 2012. It's a UK based review site, focusing on young and new adult titles. (possibly the odd adult book as well.) These have been reviewed by myself, Emma, and are an honest review and reflection of the novel sent by the publishers. This is too showcase my love and passion of books and influence/inspire the likes of me and younger people of reading as a hobby. This blog will include author interviews, blog tours, book-related features, and giveaways.

feeds.title: READING (AS)(I)AN (AM)ERICA Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, I will focus primarily on Anglophone Asian and diasporic Asian books. My name is Shenwei and I'm a 28-year-old Taiwanese American sweet potato who loves food, books, and plushies. The Reading Asian American Blog will give you book reviews through an Asian American lens.

feeds.title: Star-Crossed Book Blog
feeds.description: We review books & gravitate towards stories with romance but love Paranormal, Dystopian, Contemporary Romance, Young Adult, New Adult, Fantasy, SciFi etc. We are a group of women whose love of reading brought us together. We met on a site called Goodreads, where we each review, buddy-read, and most importantly: gush shamelessly over books! On here, you will find that our posts contain Reviews, Recommendations, Giveaways, Upcoming Releases and Cover Reveals.

feeds.title: YABookNerd
feeds.description: After spending 11 years as a Young Adult Librarian, I moved libraries and became a Children's and YA Librarian. I love love love books and talking about reading (which is why I started this blog). My favorite types of books include mysteries, romance, thrillers, and spy books. I adore crafty books, regency romances, and cozy mysteries.

feeds.title: Books by Pamela Thompson
feeds.description: When I read a YA book that I KNOW will appeal to teen readers, I make sure and review and blog it. This blog is not about award winning books or books that adults want teens to read. It is about TEEN and tween and sometimes younger readers, and sometimes it's about technology.

feeds.title: 24hryabookblog
feeds.description: Hey welcome to 24hr.YABookBlog, I'm a 21 yr. old avid reader and I love YA Books. I created this blog to connect w/ people who read just as much as I do and hopefully introduce readers to new books! Aside from book reviews, you can also expect a variety of posts to like: TBR posts about upcoming releases, reading playlists (inspired by my love of video games, and because I also really love podcasts, you can definitely expect some book/podcast related posts on my blog!

feeds.title: WandflowerBookish
feeds.description: In this blog, you can find reviews/thoughts and more about the books I read. (young adult fantasy/new adult) I hope that you will find my reviews helpful and engaging, and I will enjoy sharing my thoughts with you!

feeds.title: The Page Unbound
feeds.description: Huge fans of young adult books. We write reviews, share book related news, and blog.

feeds.title: Sheaf & Ink
feeds.description: Sheaf & Ink features an honest perspective of young adult fiction. Weekly book reviews, favorite book quotes and upcoming young adult book releases.

feeds.title: Heyit'sCarlyRae!
feeds.description: Bookstagrammer and Booktuber Carly Rae brings you the trending reviews in the book world! You can also find more about her writing journey on her blog as she shares the reality of writing. Carly is currently attending Harvard and also is an influencer for Random House, Berkley Publishing, Simon & Schuster, Doubleday Books, and more.

feeds.title: Page Turners Blog
feeds.description: We are a multiple author YA/NA Book Review blog. YA book promotion & review and boutique book to screen

feeds.title: The Sassy Book Geek
feeds.description: I'm Heather, a 22 year old book blogger and I live in the U.S. The Sassy Book Geek is all about books! It's for posting my favorite things about books, lists, reviews, talking to others about books. Books, books, books, books, and more books.

feeds.title: Oregon Young Adult Network
feeds.description: OYAN (Oregon Young Adult Network, a division of the Oregon Library Association) exists to provide a network for communications and growth among people who provide library services to teens, to increase awareness of teen library services in the state of Oregon, and to promote cooperation between school and public libraries.

feeds.title: YAdudebooks
feeds.description: YAdudebooks is a not-for-profit book-review/author profile website launched in 2021. We hope it helps educators, parents and teens find books that encourage teen boys to read.

feeds.title: Bobs Books Blog » Young Adult
feeds.description: Children's and Young Adult Book Reviews by Bob Docherty. I have enjoyed doing this work and there are nearly 2300 reviews on this blog.

feeds.title: Cocoa With Books » Young Adult
feeds.description: Find young adult fiction and non-fiction reviews. A book blog for mood readers and educators. I'm Richetta. I have a special interest in diverse literature and young adult books. Check out my reviews that also include educator recommendations as well as my book thoughts and excitement.

feeds.title: The Neverending TBR » Five Star YA
feeds.description: My name is Jaymie, and I am obsessed with books and reading! My book obsession started early, when I taught myself to read the book Bears in the Night by Stan Berenstain. My mission with The Neverending TBR is to connect readers with books so they never have to wonder what to read next. Check out the best of the YA books I have read, reviews, recommendations and more!

feeds.title: Reading Middle Grade » Young Adult
feeds.description: My name is Afoma. I'm a twenty-something writer, editor, and voracious reader with an insatiable appetite for children's literature, books by women, and articles about life and human relationships. Explore young adult books reviews, book lists and more in this section.

feeds.title: BookishBron
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Bron! I'm an Australian book blogger and reviewer, living in Ngunnawal Country in Canberra. I'm passionate about reading and supporting Australian books and authors, from kids' books to young adult and adult fiction. Join me here as I talk about my latest and favorite reads, and my bookish life.

feeds.title: Free Kids Books » Young Adult
feeds.description: Books containing content which is more suitable for a mature child. This category has chapter books (without pictures). Suitable for children over 10 years, adults, and fluent english speakers. Free Kids Books is a growing library of unique children's books, literary resources, and textbooks for children and young adults, available online and for download primarily in a user-friendly pdf format.

feeds.title: The Burgeoning Bookshelf
feeds.description: I started reading children's Middle Grade and Young Adult as my children brought English texts home from school. My reading preferences now include Romance, Rural Romance, Suspense, Mystery, Crime, Fantasy, Historical Fiction, Contemporary Women's, Young Adult, fictional war stories and Middle Grade.

feeds.title: CBY Book Club
feeds.description: My name is Al Stone, and I'm a writer from the UK. There are only a few things I can say I'm absolutely passionate about, and reading is high on the list. I aim to introduce readers to new and established talent! CBY (Chosen By You) officially launched on May 12, 2013, featuring mostly Ya books.

feeds.title: CanLit for LittleCanadians
feeds.description: CanLit for LittleCanadians is a site promoting children's and YA books by Canadian authors and illustrators. I am a bibliophile, teacher-librarian, reviewer & promoter of great Canadian reading for young people.

feeds.title: Ruei's Reading Corner
feeds.description: I'm Ruei, a Taiwanese American teen who loves reading. I enjoy reading YA contemporary, fantasy, and mystery books but as long as it's a good book, I'll read it! This blog is a catalog of books I have read and my reviews of them.

feeds.title: NewInBooks » Young Adult
feeds.description: We believe you should spend your time reading, not searching. That's why NewInBooks alerts you to all the newest books in your favorite genres. Stay up to date with the latest Young Adult genre books and upcoming book news with us.

feeds.title: DeeScribe Writing
feeds.description: I am a Children's & YA author and writing teacher. I love being a children's and YA author. I hope you find my tips, news and musings inspiring.

feeds.title: Book Riot » Young Adult Literature
feeds.description: If you are looking for the best young adult books, new YA books for your pre-order list, or young adult fiction for yourself or the teens in your life, we've got you. Book Riot is the largest independent literary site in North America, bringing you news, bookish commentary, and recs for readers of all stripes.

feeds.title: The Bookish Elf » Young Adult
feeds.description: The Bookish Elf is your single, trusted, daily source for all the news, ideas and richness of literary life. You can rely on for book reviews, author interviews, book recommendations, and all things books from YA genre.

feeds.title: LitBuzz » Young Adult
feeds.description: LitBuzz is a fun venture by a bunch of bibliophiles who love discovering new and fun authors and sharing them with the world. We have a diverse interest base, so the variety of books you find here will always be exciting and we will always be looking for more! Find author interviews and exclusives, giveaways and news about the books you can't wait to read from the Young Adult genre.

feeds.title: Independent Book Review » Middle Grade & Young Adult
feeds.description: In April 2018, we started IBR to encourage our audience to put their trust in small press and self-published books. We publish only good reviews at IBR, despite reading many more of them, so that you can trust each new publication as a recommendation from our team. Discover some of our favorites from Young Adult fictions.

feeds.title: Artisan Book Reviews » Young Adult
feeds.description: Artisan book Reviews is passionate about books and the reading experience. Our goal is to provide readers with the very best hand-picked fiction books written by remarkable and talented authors who have over-the-top captivating imaginations, outstanding writing abilities and unique stories to tell. Find captivating young adult fictions, reviews, book lists, upcoming books and authors news and promotions and more!

feeds.title: Long and Short Reviews » YA/MiddleGrade/Childrens Reviews
feeds.description: Long and Short Reviews opened its doors on August 27, 2007. We have reviewed more than 8900 books and short stories. Explore our recommendations for young adults, middle-grade children, teens, book reviews, lists and more!

feeds.title: Cracking the Cover » Young Adult
feeds.description: Cracking the Cover is a website dedicated to picture, middle-grade and young adult books. This section features reviews, author interviews and other book news from Young Adult genre.

feeds.title: One Book More » Young Adult
feeds.description: I'm Julie, and literature is my passion. I love to read, talk, and write about books. Classics, contemporary, fantasy, romance, young adult, sci-fi, poetry - they all rock! I started this blog, so I can share my love of reading with other book-lovers. Go through my YA book lists, reviews, TBR and more!

feeds.title: Good Books & Good Wine
feeds.description: I'm a Book Blogger, wine appreciator, YAvangelist, 30. We prefer to review young adult and middle grade books of all genres. In addition, we review romance, comic books, adult fiction and fantasy.

feeds.title: Tween 2 Teen Book Reviews
feeds.description: Isabel is an aspiring author who enjoys reading, writing, and reviewing books. She spends most of her free time either reading the newest YA releases or writing her various YA novels she hopes will one day be published.

feeds.title: Book Briefs
feeds.description: HI. I'm Michelle. I'm a twenty- something new attorney. I love books, dogs, organization, and Florida State Football. Book Briefs is a Young Adult and New Adult Book Review blog, bringing you Young Adult book reviews since 2011

feeds.title: Ohnobooks
feeds.description: Ohnobooks compiles the bookish thoughts of a bookworm trio of Aro, Andi, and Ame. They read, review, and reflect on a number of books from a wide variety of genres for fiction titles. Stay tuned and read the latest post devouring new releases.

feeds.title: The Reader and the Chef
feeds.description: I love reading fantasy, paranormal and basically all things YA with a hint of romance, but I also enjoy reading New Adult, Classics and sometimes Adult novels. I strongly believe that books are the perfect companions and all the therapy you need when you want to escape from reality and dive into amazing worlds.

feeds.title: The Plain-Spoken Pen » Young Adult
feeds.description: Explore the young adult section for reviews of books I have read, upcoming releases and more! Hi! I'm Lisa, the reader and reviewer behind The Plain-Spoken Pen. I've been reading since I was 3 years old.

feeds.title: Kait Plus Books
feeds.description: A blog by Kait who mostly read YA books and occasionally branch out to the middle grade & adult genre. Blog posts cover typically interviews, excerpts, or reviews, and sometimes bookish memes.

feeds.title: Parrot Street Book Club Blog » Young Adult
feeds.description: Young adult book news and reviews, author interviews, activity ideas and reading for pleasure ideas from the Parrot Street Book Club team. Parrot Street Book Club is a monthly book subscription for kids aged 5 to 11. Every month we will send your child a new book for them to keep. We will also provide an activity pack that includes fun book club-style questions for your child to discuss with their friends and family.

feeds.title: Njkinny's Blog » young adult
feeds.description: Explore book reviews and recommendations of various young adult books. Njkinny is a total bookworm who loves reading books across genres and enjoys sharing her thoughts on the books she is reading. This page is where she talks Book Reviews, Recommendations, Giveaways , Deals and everything bookish.

feeds.title: bookGeeks » Young Adult Novels
feeds.description: Are you looking for some good Indian YA Books to read? bookGeeks has one of the largest collection of reviews of Indian Young Adult Books and Novels. bookGeeks provides the best Book Marketing Services in India.

feeds.title: Book Review Buzz
feeds.description: We started this site to help authors reach book reviewers, readers, bloggers, and the media. Our goal is to list books available for review and eventually start posting actual book reviews.

feeds.title: Reading Rants
feeds.description: A group of booklists for teens out there who need a good read. I believe that teens can and should read anything that they want to or feel that they are ready for.

feeds.title: Burning Impossibly Bright Blog
feeds.description: Burning Impossibly Bright is a blog dedicated mostly to books run by Ambur, a Canadian girl with a BA in English who's addicted to books. It focuses mainly on young adult and romance with some additional genres thrown in. You'll find reviews, interviews, guest posts, giveaways, and other randomness.

feeds.title: Annette's Book Spot
feeds.description: A blog featuring Young Adult Book Reviews written by a high school librarian. I love to read. I read mostly YA, my favorite is historical fiction, but I mix in the occasional adult novel and even some nonfiction.

feeds.title: A Dream of Books
feeds.description: A feast of YA fiction - chat, news and reviews

feeds.title: The Uncharted Word
feeds.description: I mostly read YA books of all genres, majority fantasy, and a little bit of adult fantasy and thrillers, so I hope my posts and reviews speak to all you bookworms out there.

feeds.title: Once Upon a Bookcase
feeds.description: I'm Jo, a Children's Bookseller, and I have been book blogging since 2009. Once Upon a Bookcase is my little corner of the internet where I share my love of YA - especially diverse YA, fantasy, some children's books, and whatever else takes my fancy.

feeds.title: Revolutionary Readers
feeds.description: Revolutionary Readers is a Sci-Fi/Fantasy (plus more!) book blog for kids between ages 11-16. Your host, Valkyrie, has a soft spot for villains, a hankering for twisted tales, and a passion for princesses who are actually cyborgs. Subscribe this feed to get more updates.

feeds.title: YA Sci-Fi & Fantasy Addicts Blog
feeds.description: Featuring reviews, discussion, lists, games, reading challenges, and giveaways.

feeds.title: Pages for Thoughts
feeds.description: YA Book Reviews by a Young Adult Named Julia. She loves reading YA realistic fiction, fantasy, and science fiction!

feeds.title: Of Pens and Swords
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to my blog, Of Pens and Swords. I have loved reading all my life, and I am starting this book blog with the hopes of being able to share and discuss my opinions of the various books I read! I am a high-schooler, and I mostly read YA books, though I do stray into middle grade sometimes and adult fiction on rare occasions. On this blog I will primarily be posting reviews and discussion posts, though I am open to other possibilities.

feeds.title: Librarian Laura
feeds.description: I'm an MLS librarian and Regional Coordinator with the Indiana State Library. I love to read anything and everything Fiction, and especially enjoy blogging reviews. My favorite genres are Romance (RomCom for the win!), Mystery/Suspense/Thriller, and Historical Fiction (mostly WWII). I review for both School Library Journal and Library Journal. I began a book review blog so I could highlight the books that I've read and the ones that I love.

feeds.title: World of Books Blog
feeds.description: I have been a teacher for too many years to count. I've taught Pre-K, Kindergarten, 3rd, 4th, and 5th grades. World of Books is a resource for young adult and children's literature featuring book reviews and recommendations.

feeds.title: Golden Books Girl Blog
feeds.description: I'm Amy, a Scottish award-winning (bizarre, I know) teen blogger of mainly MG and YA books. My favorite genres within the age categories I review include mystery/adventure, historical/timeslip, fantasy, magical realism, romance and contemporary.

feeds.title: A Little Book Problem » Young Adult
feeds.description: My name is Julie, I'm 50 and I am a book addict. Seriously, it is a severe and untreatable problem, hence the name of my blog. I have now been book blogging for almost six years, and my blog has grown in popularity and ambition during that time. As well as book reviews, I now host interview features, frequent guest posts and sometimes post about non-book-related topics. Explore book reviews on the Young adult fiction I read, my recommendations and TBR list.

feeds.title: Blogging with Dragons » Young Adult
feeds.description: Welcome to Blogging with Dragons! I'm Kate, a bookwyrm, gamer, foodie, knitter, Korean drama binge watcher, and lover of all things geeky. Go through my YA book reviews to know what I recommend in the genre.

feeds.title: Maya's Reviews » Young Adult Reviews
feeds.description: My name is Maya, and I run Maya's Reviews, a book blog and podcast. I'm a book blogger, movie reviewer, podcaster, and dedicated student who spends way too much time reading books and watching movies. Go through my Young Adult books' reviews, interviews with YA authors and more!

feeds.title: A Tapestry Of Words
feeds.description: An avid reader & chocoholic! Working as a speech-language pathologist at a school for children with special needs. Genre-wise I am a fairly eclectic reader, as I like to read fantasy, realistic fiction, dystopian, historical fiction, and some mysteries. I am also fond of some classics, particularly Jane Austen. Check out my blog for book reviews!

feeds.title: Tessa Talks Books » Young Adult
feeds.description: I am a counselor who works for a nonprofit that aids the economically disadvantaged. And I am a voracious reader who loves mysteries, thrillers, fantasy, SciFi, women's fiction and romantic comedies. Follow along as I note down some of the best books YA books I have read and their reviews.

feeds.title: YA Books Daily
feeds.description: We write reviews of YA books and discuss all our favorite things about the genre. We give recommendations, participate in weekly events, and just generally spread our love for the books we hold close to our hearts. Our reading tastes may span far more than one genre, but this blog is solely dedicated to bringing you all things YA.

feeds.title: Babbling Books Blog » Young Adult
feeds.description: My name is Taylor and you've probably stumbled on this blog because you love books, well that's great because I do too! I'm a 29-year-old Florida girl who adores animals, vintage / antique treasures and anything Disney! I want this blog to be a fun place for everyone to look around and find their next great read as well as a forum for us to just share our love for books, whether they be hardback, paperback, or on a digital device. Join in as I review young adult fiction books I read and liked in this section.

feeds.title: Margie's Must Reads » Young Adult
feeds.description: Margarita Longoria is a lifelong bookworm, book blogger, young adult book expert and an award-winning high school librarian in South Texas. She is the founder of Border Book Bash: Celebrating Teens and Tweens of the Rio Grande Valley and served on state reading committees for the Texas Library Association. Margie's Must Reads is where she lists the best books on market that should be in every reader's TBR list. Check out her recommendations, reviews and more from YA genre.

feeds.title: Jenjenreviews » Young Adult
feeds.description: I go by Jenny online. I decided to start this blog because I love reading but have a terrible memory. There are many books that I think about rereading only to realize that I don't remember if I even enjoyed them the first time. DIscover which books you would like to read with the help of my reviews of Young Adult books I have read so far!

feeds.title: Leaf's Reviews » Young Adult
feeds.description: Check out the Young Adult book reviews, news on new books and more! Leaf's Reviews provides reviews of Young Adult, Middle Grade, and Children's books, predominantly in the genre of Fantasy and Historical Fiction, but branching out in other genres, as well. The aim for creating this blog was to serve as a reference for those looking for books themselves.

feeds.title: Pooled Ink » Young Adult Fiction
feeds.description: This is a space I've created to babble honestly about books. I'll try to avoid going on and on about them like a leaky faucet and keep it a crisp and clean review site. Join me as I share my thoughts and opinions on the young adult fictions I have liked, loved and sometimes hated.

feeds.title: Chick Lit Cafe » Young Adult
feeds.description: Chick Lit Café's main goal is to provide readers with the very best fiction books from the market written by remarkable and talented authors who have unique stories to tell. We also provide author services for target audience promotions. Check out our best of the recommendations for young adult fictions, book lists, latest book news and more!

feeds.title: The Spine View » Young Adult
feeds.description: I'm Lisa, a southern bibliophile living in the heart of the Great Smoky Mountains with my husband and band of fur children. The Spine View is all about my life as a bibliophile. I love to talk about the books I read and make recommendations. I am always looking for my next great read. This section features the YA books I have read, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Perpetual Page Turner » Young Adult Fiction
feeds.description: I'm Jamie! I'm the blogger behind The Perpetual Page-Turner and I've been blogging here since June 2010. I started this blog as a way to chronicle what I've been reading, swap book recommendations and just talk all things books as I didn't have anyone in my life who related to my bookworm tendencies. Check out my book recommendations and book lists for adults and middle schoolers.

feeds.title: The Book Nanny » Teen / YA
feeds.description: A look inside your book. I read it and let you know what the language, adult content and violence look like without spoilers. Take a look inside the books your teens/Young adults are reading so that you aren't surprised.

feeds.title: Kids Lit Book Cafe » Young Adult
feeds.description: Kids Lit Book Cafe is passionate about children's books and the reading experience for children of all ages. Browse through our Young Adult section for the latest books in the genre, popular books reviews and more!

feeds.title: Literary Quicksand » Young Adult
feeds.description: We're a book blog based out of Minneapolis, Minnesota. We feature a group of women writers in multiple countries who've all come together over one thing: our love for books and all things bookish! Explore our Young Adult book reviews, book lists, TBR roundups, and more.

feeds.title: Bookstacked
feeds.description: The ultimate site for YA book news, YA book reviews, and YA book discussion. Bookstacked is your new one-stop source for the latest and greatest in YA books. From book reviews to news of Fantastic Beasts, Red Queen, and Shadowhunters, Bookstacked is the BEST site for YA book news.

feeds.title: The Candid Cover
feeds.description: Olivia is a Canadian young adult book blogger. She reviews books and conducts author Interviews, giveaways, and discussions. She rates books from one to five stars based on the characters, setting, writing style, and overall enjoyment of the book. Her blog The Candid Cover features Young Adult books, audiobooks, and book-to-movie adaptations thorough information and engaging posts.

feeds.title: Paperback'd Reviews
feeds.description: I am Lucy. I spend most of my spare time reading, reviewing and fangirling over YA lit. I'm open to reading any genre, but my main love is YA lit.

feeds.title: YA Books Central Blog
feeds.description: YABC is your first stop for all things book-related! Founded in 1998 by (now author) Kimberly Pauley as a basic stopover for people looking for information on young adult books, YABC has since evolved into one of the largest professional book recommendation sites targeted towards tween and teen readers.
